title: You talk. It's done.
lines: You talk. It's done.
No typing out the prompt. No fiddling with settings.
In Freddai you pick a project, press the mic, and just say what you want.
Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page. Like you'd tell a person.
It becomes a thread, and the agent gets to work.
Talk, and it's done.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Set it and forget it
lines: Set it. Forget it.
Start a task, then go do something else.
No babysitting a terminal. No watching it type.
Freddai lets every agent run on its own, and keeps every thread in one place.
Come back later and the finished ones are already sitting there, done.
Set and forget. Finally.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Pick the account for each thread
lines: Which account should take this one?
Your main one is nearly empty. Your other one is wide open.
In Freddai, you choose the account for every new thread.
Open the picker, tap the one with room, and send it.
Same project, different account. That's all it takes.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: One account is never enough
lines: Vibe coders burn through usage. One account is never enough.
So you get a second one. Then a third.
Then you spend half your day logging in and out.
Freddai keeps all of them signed in, side by side. Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok.
Mark one as the default, and switch whenever you want.
Accounts stop being a chore.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Limit hit mid-flow
lines: Limit hit. Right in the middle of a good run.
Normally, that's your evening gone.
The banner says come back in a few hours.
In Freddai, you just pick another account.
The thread keeps going. You never log out, and you never lose your place.
Same project, same thread, new account.
Limits stop being a big deal.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Know what's left
lines: Know what's left before it runs out.
Freddai shows every account's usage in one strip.
Percent remaining, and when it resets.
Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok. All in the same place.
One ring turns amber. That's your cue to switch.
No more opening three apps to check.
Switch, and keep vibing.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Vibe code from the couch
lines: Vibe code from the couch.
Start the work at your desk. Then walk away.
Walk the dog. Make a coffee. Go outside.
Freddai works on your phone too. It pings you when an agent needs something.
Reply or approve, and it carries on. The Mac does the heavy lifting.
Your desk is optional.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Four agents, one smooth desk
lines: Claude. Codex. Gemini. Grok.
Different agents, usually in different apps.
No hopping between apps to find the right one.
In Freddai it's one desk. Pick the project, pick the agent, go.
No setup rituals. No tab juggling. It just flows.
Start another thread while the first one runs.
That's the whole point. Smooth.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Vibe code while you sleep
lines: Vibe code while you sleep.
Some jobs come back every day. Update the dependencies. Triage the issues.
Give them a schedule in Freddai. Weekdays, nine a.m.
Set it once. It runs by itself, and the next run is right there on the card.
Set and forget, on a timer.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.

title: Your agent can use your Mac
lines: Your agent can use your Mac.
Not just write code. Actually click things.
Open an app. Press a button. Fill in a form.
Freddai gives agents computer control, with a visible cursor working in the background.
Your own windows stay yours. You keep working while it does.
Give it a job, and watch the cursor go.
Talk, and it's done. Even the clicking.
Freddai. Give all your agents a home.
